summary: Comprehensive testing of widget positioning, overlay system, and LobbyDisplay refactoring. All 11 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified: 7 admin tabs present, Widget Positioning panel with 4 widgets and 6 position spots, Overlay CRUD working (create/toggle/delete), photo slides show widgets at corners (clock top-right, weather bottom-left, news bottom-right) without blocking photo center.

Backend: PUT /api/settings accepts widget_positions updates
Backend: GET /api/overlays returns list of overlays
Backend: POST /api/overlays creates banner overlay
Backend: POST /api/overlays supports all styles (banner, ticker, corner, fullscreen)
Backend: PUT /api/overlays/{id} updates overlay
Backend: DELETE /api/overlays/{id} deletes overlay
Backend: DELETE /api/overlays/{id} returns 404 for nonexistent overlay
Backend: GET /api/overlays/active returns only enabled overlays
Backend: Toggle overlay enabled/disabled works correctly
Backend: Portrait 4:3 7.5x10 settings verified
Frontend: Admin panel has 7 tabs (Images, Attractions, Events, Content, Settings, Display, Overlays)
Frontend: Display tab shows Widget Positioning panel
Frontend: Widget Positioning has 4 widget buttons (Hotel Name, Clock, Weather, News)
Frontend: Widget Positioning has 6 position spots (top-left, top-center, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-center, bottom-right)
Frontend: Widget positioning interaction works (select widget, click position to move)
Frontend: Overlays tab shows Add Overlay button
Frontend: Overlay creation form has title, style, message, colors, priority fields
Frontend: Overlay CRUD works (create shows toast, toggle works, delete removes from list)
Frontend: Photo slide shows clock at top-right (x=635, y=0)
Frontend: Photo slide shows weather at bottom-left (x=0, y=886)
Frontend: Photo slide shows news at bottom-right (x=390, y=915)
Frontend: Widgets do NOT block center of photo

critical_code_review_comments: LobbyDisplay.jsx correctly refactored to use PhotoSlide, SlideIndicators, OverlayDisplay sub-components
PhotoSlide.jsx uses widget_positions from settings for absolute positioning with positionStyle() helper
Widget positions use percentage-based grid (0, 50, 100 for x/y) mapped to CSS left/right/top/bottom
OverlayDisplay.jsx supports 4 overlay styles: banner (top), corner (bottom-right), fullscreen, ticker (scrolling bottom)

Backend Settings model includes widget_positions with default positions for all 4 widgets
